browser: The user's stable Google Chrome, driven through the official Claude in Chrome extension in its own tab-group window. Keys were synthetic in-page keydown/keyup events; touch buttons, Start, the language switch, menu cells on the canvas and Play again were real mouse clicks. Only visible DOM text and the drawn canvas were read; no game state was read or injected.
phoneLayouts: Checked in a same-origin 390-wide portrait frame on the page (371 px inner width, no horizontal overflow).
servedSourceCheck: The SHA-256 of all five served tide-lock modules was computed in the page and matched 3de9ca34, 4020d180, 3979bb78, 6acd43a7 and 79e1c7c3.

observed: A driver that reads only the status line, with a 0.35 s reaction delay, played locks 1 to 22 in English back to back in 29 minutes and reached 'Nicely played! Every lock is cleared. The whole fleet is home!' with a score of 11361. It never pressed Enter: no reset, stuck, stranded or give-up prompt appeared, and no hull was lost.

When X or an arrow must be pressed more than once to reach a control, the prompt names the target and keeps the same text, so the driver repeated the key after 1.5 s without a change (115 repeats over the campaign), as a player would.
The game paused itself twice when the browser window lost focus; the driver pressed the visible Resume button, and play continued where it stopped.
Chinese lock select listed all 22 locks; one tap on the canvas selected lock 4 and a second tap entered it.

Chinese: on lock 4, opening the drain with the boat inside (three Right presses and Space) first showed the rescue '空格：关闭 V4，保持水位', then '船搁浅了，来不及浮起：按回车重置'. Ignoring it lost all three hulls in about 9 s and ended the run with '三条船体都损毁了，船队覆没！'. Arrows, X and Space on the loss screen changed nothing, and Play again returned to lock select.

Chinese phone frame: real taps on the touch buttons alone, following the prompt, cleared locks 1 and 2. On lock 3 the Valve+ button moved the selection, and two taps on Reset while water was moving (the first showing the press-again warning on the canvas) reset the lock.
At 371 px the Chinese header '船闸 3/22 停在标记处 · 选择 V2（→）' fits without clipping.

limitations: Physical phones, other browsers, the English phone header and audio were not tested; console output was not captured. Synthetic pointer events cannot drive the touch buttons because they call setPointerCapture, so touch play used real clicks.
